subject.title: fix(codex): prefer recovered replies over stale failure banners

question: Should failed Codex conversation turns be allowed to resolve from partial streamed assistant deltas, or only from completed assistant-message evidence?
rationale: Codex exposes deltas as streamed progress and `item/completed` as authoritative final item state, so accepting partial deltas changes user-visible failure delivery semantics beyond a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Require completed assistant evidence
options.body: Suppress failed-turn errors only when an `item/completed` or `turn.items` agent message provides final text, while partial-delta-only failed turns still reject.

options.title: Accept partial-delta recovery
options.body: Allow partial streamed deltas to replace failed-turn banners, but document the intentional delivery tradeoff and require live proof for fatal and recovered cases.

options.title: Wait for upstream signal
options.body: Pause this PR until Codex exposes a clearer recovered-vs-fatal completion signal for clients.

recommendation.title: Require completed assistant evidence
recommendation.body: Suppress failed-turn errors only when an `item/completed` or `turn.items` agent message provides final text, while partial-delta-only failed turns still reject.

likelyOwner.reason: This account introduced and recently maintained the Codex app-server bridge and collector path where the delivery contract lives.
